title: Design: the Matrices list's Audit Log
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the three-dot button beside New Matrix.
  3. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • A small menu opens below the button with one row, Audit Log.

Step 3:

  • A dialog titled "Audit Log: Matrices" opens.
  • Its columns read Event, User, Details, Date and Time; each detail starts with the matrix name in bold and shows the change with an arrow, as in picture 6.14.
  • An X sits at the top right and Close at the bottom right.
